arithmetic: Exact Python Fraction and integer identities only; finite algebra supports the analytic all-mode and all-Dyson-order arguments in proof.md.

group_1_uniform_mode_energy_covariance_a.energy_budget: sum_k n_k*e_k(t_ref)<=E_star; n_k>=0 diagonal Gaussian, all modes retained

all_mode_covariance.z_k: ell/sqrt(V) * exp(i k.x0) * h_hat(ell*k) * integral chi(s)u_k(tau+ell*s)ds
all_mode_covariance.cross_covariance: |Delta W(F_i,F_j)|<=sqrt(Delta V_i Delta V_j)<=D for the common scale family
all_mode_covariance.zero_mode: h_hat(0)=0; no zero-mode removal from the field
all_mode_covariance.finite_shell_upgrade: fixed k shell gives O(E_star*ell^6), while all-mode uniform bound is O(E_star*ell^4)

complete_mean_excitation_source.flux: Euclidean norm of orthonormal-frame Delta T_0i <= Delta rho, including non-even occupation families
complete_mean_excitation_source.pressure: every spatial unit-direction pressure obeys |Delta T_vv|<=Delta rho; hence all orthonormal spatial components bounded by Delta rho
complete_mean_excitation_source.null: 0<=Delta T_ab k^a k^b<=4*Delta rho*(k^hat0)^2 for null k
complete_mean_excitation_source.renormalization: state difference at a common subtraction prescription; not the reference vacuum source
complete_mean_excitation_source.normality: mass 1 and the Wronskian imply e_k>=omega_k>=1, so sum n_k<=E_star at t_ref
complete_mean_excitation_source.Hadamard_scope: finite energy alone does not imply Hadamard; retain Hadamard-qualified members if that qualification is required

group_2_explicit_bump_and_constants.b1: C*exp(-1/(1-s^2)) for |s|<1, zero otherwise, integral b1=1
group_2_explicit_bump_and_constants.moments: integral h=0 and integral x_i h=0 by compact-support integration by parts
group_2_explicit_bump_and_constants.C2_qualification: Fourier identity h_hat(q)=(q2^2-q1^2)b_hat(q), |b_hat|<=1; this is NOT a claim that the Taylor second-moment integral equals 1

group_3_bounded_Dyson_and_nonempty_finit.test_probe_scope: norm-convergent bounded Dyson test; not an autonomous instantaneous implementation of time-smeared fields in the original mother action
group_3_bounded_Dyson_and_nonempty_finit.common_CCR: Weyl product phase is state-independent and equal for both compared states
group_3_bounded_Dyson_and_nonempty_finit.single_word_difference: at r field-cos letters, absolute expectation difference <=r^2 D/2
group_3_bounded_Dyson_and_nonempty_finit.all_order_proof: binomial factorial identity and r^2=r+r(r-1); differentiate exp(2L)

finite_nonempty_contract.spatial_support: translated cube of side 2 ell on the period-10 torus; fixed patch chosen without wrap
finite_nonempty_contract.orthonormal_flux_and_each_pressure_compo: bounded by the same Delta rho
finite_nonempty_contract.nonvacuum_members_exist: any finite-mode Gaussian occupation with 0<n_k<E_star/e_k(t_ref); no infinite energy required

group_3_bounded_Dyson_and_nonempty_finit.finite_shell_interpretation: For fixed shell and fixed gain, nonzero fixed probability separation under this shrinking menu requires growing energy at least of order ell^-6; a baseline-normalized effect additionally needs a baseline-variance lower bound.

net_result: A common finite energy bound uniformly controls local covariance, bounded finite-coupling test probabilities, and the complete mean excitation source in the declared Gaussian family, with an explicit nonempty finite menu; no unique physical reference or complete gravity claim.
